name: Omnium Ingot
lore: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.

name: Transcendent Metal Ingot
lore: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.

name: Computronium Ingot
lore: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.

name: Chronosteel Ingot
lore: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.

name: Hypernova Alloy Ingot
lore: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.

name: Flerovium Ingot
lore: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.

name: Anti-Gold Ingot
lore: Anti-gold: as soft, as dense and as noble as gold. Do not wear it.

name: Omniscience Catalyst
lore: All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.

name: Eternity Catalyst
lore: Time flows through it without passing. Required (not consumed) by the final processes.

name: Transcendental Crystal
lore: π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Only found in the Platonic Realm.

name: Grand Unified Core
lore: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.

name: Stellar Core
lore: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole.

name: Horizon Shard
lore: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.

name: Crystallised Law
lore: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.
